title: Azoth palette entry
description: One unit operation as the palette offers it: the parameters a user types on its form, and the ports a flowsheet connects. Read by `crates/azoth-process/src/unit_op.rs` and by the middleware, and it is the only spec tree that until now had no schema at all - so its `notes` field grew to five thousand characters with nothing validating it, while `docs/src/architecture/spec-files.md` stated the format as "a spec file declares ... no prose fields".

id.description: Dotted identifier, e.g. `unit_ops.throttling_valve`. The leaf names the file and the kernel the executor dispatches to.

source.description: Where the arithmetic came from, as a citation. Optional, and held to the same shape a calc's is.

parameters.description: The parameters a user types on the form, by name. A parameter the entry does not declare is one the form does not offer - which is the statement, and the reason a withdrawn parameter needs no note.

unit.description: The parameter's canonical unit, for a quantity. Omitted for an enum, a boolean, a name, or a quantity whose unit follows another parameter's - the distillation column's specification target is the one.

required.description: Whether a kernel can run without it. `false` by default, and the executor reads the two with different families of accessor, so this is a fact about the code rather than a hint.

ports.description: The declared interface of each side of the unit operation.

multiplicity.description: How many streams the port carries. `one` by default; `many` is a mixer's inlets or a splitter's outlets.

fields.description: The field record a stream on this port carries, by field name.

shape.description: Whether the field is one quantity or one entry per component. `scalar` by default.

unported.description: The NeqSim capability this entry does not carry, for an entry with no model spec to declare it. **`process` models declare their own rows in `[[unported]]`; a palette entry declares one only where no model spec of the same leaf exists**, so the same fact is never written twice - which is how a corrected claim in one file left its twin lying in the other.

class.description: The NeqSim class that would close the gap, as a symbol with no sentence around it.

capture.description: The probe capture that measures the refusal, where one does.
